complete_examples.text: Submit your article to this journal View Crossmark data A spectral evolution model for track geometric degradation in train–track long-term dynamics Lei Xu and Wanming Zhai Key Laboratory of Traction Power, Train and Track Research Institute, Southwest Jiaotong University, Chengdu, People’s Republic of China ABSTRACT In this work, a new insight is put forward to characterise the evolution of track irregularities from viewpoint of spectral analysis.

The previous settlement laws, e.g. ORE model [19] and its application [20], can show track geometric degradation for references, in which the irregularity amplitudes could be predicted against the cyclic loads.
